description: This Java class 'PowerSaving' provides reactive observables to monitor and determine the device's power saving state, including battery and charger status, as well as system power save mode.

classes.name: PowerSaving
classes.description: Provides reactive streams to observe device power saving states, including battery and charger status, and system power save mode.

methods.name: observePowerSavingState
methods.description: Returns an Observable<Boolean> that emits the current power saving state based on user preferences, battery status, charger status, and system power save mode.

methods.name: observePowerSavingState
methods.description: Overloaded method that uses default preference value to observe power saving state.

methods.name: getOsPowerSavingStateObservable
methods.description: Creates an Observable<Boolean> that emits the system's power save mode status.

methods.name: getPowerSavingIntentFilter
methods.description: Constructs an IntentFilter for power save mode change actions.

methods.name: getBatteryStateIntentFilter
methods.description: Constructs an IntentFilter for battery low and okay actions.

methods.name: getChargerStateIntentFilter
methods.description: Constructs an IntentFilter for charger connected and disconnected actions.
